default_layout.description: The default layout mode for the viewer (e.g., single, grid, presenter).

background_color.description: Background color in hex format (ARGB) for normal view.

background_color_fullscreen.description: Background color in hex format (ARGB) for fullscreen mode.

unrendered_page_color.description: Color shown for pages that have not yet been rendered.

click_link_button.description: Mouse button index to use for clicking links (1=Left, 2=Middle, 3=Right).

drag_view_button.description: Mouse button index to use for dragging/panning the view.

select_text_button.description: Mouse button index to use for selecting text.

hide_mouse_timeout.description: Time in milliseconds to wait before hiding the mouse cursor.

smooth_scroll_delta.description: The delta value for smooth scrolling operations.

screen_scroll_factor.description: Fraction of the screen height to scroll when using screen scroll commands.

jump_padding.description: Padding fraction applied around the target position when jumping.

rect_margin.description: Margin in pixels around rectangular selections or annotations.

useless_gap.description: Gap size in pixels between layout elements (e.g., in grid mode).

zoom_factor.description: Step size for zoom in/out operations.

min_page_width.description: Minimum page width in pixels for layout calculations.

presenter_slide_ratio.description: Aspect ratio or proportion used for presenter mode layouts.

quit_on_init_fail.description: Whether to quit immediately if initialization fails.

single_instance_per_file.description: If true, enforce a single instance window per file.

stylesheet.description: Path to an optional CSS stylesheet for customization. Empty string for none.

page_overlay_text.description: Format string for the page counter overlay (%1=current, %2=total).

icon_theme.description: Name of the icon theme to use for UI elements. Empty for default.

prefetch_count.description: Number of adjacent pages to prefetch/render in advance.

inverted_color_contrast.description: Contrast adjustment factor for inverted color mode.

inverted_color_brightening.description: Brightening factor applied to colors in inverted mode.

mouse_wheel_factor.description: Delta value reported by mouse wheel events.

thumbnail_size.description: Width/height in pixels for generated thumbnails.

key_top.description: Keybinding for going to the top of the document.

key_bottom.description: Keybinding for going to the bottom of the document.

key_goto_page.description: Keybinding for jumping to a specific page number.

key_half_screen_up.description: Keybinding for scrolling half screen up.

key_half_screen_down.description: Keybinding for scrolling half screen down.

key_screen_up.description: Keybinding for scrolling one screen up.

key_screen_down.description: Keybinding for scrolling one screen down.

key_next_hit.description: Keybinding for finding the next search hit.

key_previous_hit.description: Keybinding for finding the previous search hit.

key_next_invisible_hit.description: Keybinding for finding the next invisible hit.

key_previous_invisible_hit.description: Keybinding for finding the previous invisible hit.

key_jump_back.description: Keybinding for jumping back in navigation history.

key_jump_forward.description: Keybinding for jumping forward in navigation history.

key_mark_jump.description: Keybinding for marking or jumping to a marked location.

key_set_single_layout.description: Keybinding to set single layout mode.

key_set_grid_layout.description: Keybinding to set grid layout mode.

key_set_presenter_layout.description: Keybinding to set presenter layout mode.

key_increase_columns.description: Keybinding to increase the number of columns in grid view.

key_decrease_columns.description: Keybinding to decrease the number of columns in grid view.

key_increase_offset.description: Keybinding to increase the offset/position in grid view.

key_decrease_offset.description: Keybinding to decrease the offset/position in grid view.

key_rotate_left.description: Keybinding to rotate the page left.

key_rotate_right.description: Keybinding to rotate the page right.

key_toggle_overlay.description: Keybinding to toggle the overlay (page counter/status).

key_close_search.description: Keybinding to close the search bar.

key_copy_to_clipboard.description: Keybinding to copy selected text to clipboard.

key_swap_selection_and_panning_buttons.description: Keybinding to swap the roles of selection and panning buttons.

key_reload.description: Keybinding to reload the current document.

key_open.description: Keybinding to open a new file.

key_save.description: Keybinding to save current state or document.

key_toggle_toc.description: Keybinding to toggle the table of contents view.

key_freeze_presentation.description: Keybinding to freeze the current presentation slide.
